title: Birdcar, a new visual world
question: Clean typography. Purposeful motion. Silicon Valley capability, made personally accessible. Keep the offer and voice; choose the new visual direction. These are generated composition previews; the build uses the actual licensed Alkaline files. Motion respects reduced-motion preferences and all copy stays available without JavaScript.

options.label: Future, in person
options.thesis: Silicon Valley fluency, with a person you can talk to.
materials: precise type, deep color, a luminous horizon
options.viewport: A spacious centered Alkaline statement, plain first-person explanation and immediate assessment action; the next passage emerges below a fine optical horizon. Motion: headline lines settle once; the luminous horizon opens as the visitor moves into the work story.
options.risk: The dark opening needs warm, direct copy to keep the relationship personal.

raised.raise: Pace each passage as part of one deliberate sequence.
Give the opening one focal statement and a visible action.
Let color enter in an intentional order rather than animate everything.
Every destination and next step remains an ordinary, explicit link.
Use one consistent settling rhythm for purposeful motion.

options.label: Applied Future
options.lineage: Classic technology identity, with a personal signature
options.thesis: Advanced technical capability with a clear, practical invitation.
materials: cobalt fields, white space, precise light
options.viewport: Left-aligned Alkaline on a broad cobalt field, supporting copy and action directly below; a clean white work preview anchors the fold. Motion: precise type entrances and a moving light edge lead into the work; the cobalt field gives way to readable white sections.
options.risk: Its technology-brand familiarity is reassuring, but less surprising than the lead.

options.label: Clear structure
options.lineage: Glazier colorfield partition, translated into a precise digital page
options.thesis: Sophisticated technology, made clear one pane at a time.
materials: clear fields, hairline divisions, optical light
options.viewport: One broad headline pane and a narrower assessment pane; a clear blue field moves between them. Motion: clear regions brighten on hover or keyboard focus; each section has one purpose and the reading order stays ordinary.
options.case: Holds product clarity through explicit regions; the divided composition is less personal than the lead.
options.risk: Requires restraint to avoid looking like a software dashboard.

options.label: Film sequence
options.thesis: The work unfolds as a sequence of framed explanations.
options.viewport: A framed sequence progresses from workflow pain to the report and implementation.
options.case: Loses audience identification and clarity: film controls and artifacts compete with a practical service.
options.kept: Pace each passage as part of one deliberate sequence.

options.label: One thing at a time
options.thesis: Each work problem receives an uninterrupted full-screen moment.
options.viewport: A full-height work scene leads to the offer in the following viewport.
options.case: Loses audience identification and clarity: feed navigation separates the promise from the action.
options.risk: Compulsory paging slows a buyer trying to scan.
options.kept: Give the opening one focal statement and a visible action.

options.label: Registered color
options.thesis: The explanation builds through successive color layers.
options.viewport: An illustrative subject develops through layers beside the offer.
options.case: Loses audience identification and clarity: the print ritual suggests craft production more than technical delivery.
options.risk: Returns to the illustrative direction you are leaving.
options.kept: Let color enter in an intentional order rather than animate everything.

options.label: Linked knowledge
options.thesis: A connected set of cards makes the engagement explorable.
options.viewport: A home card links to problems, work, and assessment details.
options.case: Loses audience identification and clarity: authoring controls and retro navigation misstate the service.
options.kept: Every destination and next step remains an ordinary, explicit link.

options.label: Measured motion
options.thesis: A coordinated bank of instruments makes progress visible.
options.viewport: An instrument-like row compares work moving through the business.
options.case: Loses audience identification and clarity: live meters would imply measurements this site does not provide.
options.kept: Use one consistent settling rhythm for purposeful motion.

canonCard.label: Classic technology consultancy
canonCard.thesis: A familiar, polished structure with your signature lettering.
materials: Alkaline logo + Public Sans + Commit Mono
white canvas, navy type, blue controls
canonCard.viewport: White navigation and a conventional split hero put the promise beside the assessment explanation; proof follows.
canonCard.risk: Easy to understand, but close to other technology-service sites.
